# Grok 1.0.77 late input evidence (#3810)

Captured 2026-11-13 with the actual Linux x86_64 Grok 1.0.77 binary from `https://x.ai/cli/grok-1.0.77-linux-x86_64`. Its SHA-256 matches the existing 1.0.77 audit pin (`b702950aa5827d855e493278ab6215a4e0f5bceb5bba6c6243a9f55cdd143b0a`). This is CLI output against a mock, not real account traffic or a reproduction of the reporter's original pane failure.

The owned rig used host private tmux socket `sentinel-grok3810` at 120×40, wrapping a single `node:22-bookworm` container named `sentinel-grok3810-capture`, with `--network none`, a scratch HOME `/rig/home` and cwd `/rig/work`. It mounted only the owned rig directory. The existing `grok-1.0.77-audit/rig/mock.cjs` ran inside the container on loopback port18080. A dummy API key and the three API base URL overrides pointed the CLI to that mock; `--no-auto-update --no-leader --always-approve --session-id 4b388fc1-2601-4552-bd03-4a6e2edcf8e0` selected the launch. No login, real account, host credential mount, network, tool execution or data-sharing choice was used.

Steps: capture ready; bracket-paste the inert delivery marker plus `please stall owned receipt fixture` without Enter; capture draft and chat history (updates.jsonl did not exist); press Enter once; immediately retain submitted updates and pane; allow the mock's eight-second response; retain completion and pane. `/new` then generated a different session UUID, confirming that newest-cwd discovery is unsuitable for ownership. Stop the container and private tmux server; both were independently absent after cleanup.

The JSONL and summary files retain the real CLI schema/IDs/timestamps. Their content is entirely synthetic. `draft.chat.jsonl` contains public built-in CLI prompts, not credentials. No OAuth/auth/config files are retained. `submitted.updates.jsonl` records `session/update`, the exact `params.sessionId`, and `update.sessionUpdate=user_message_chunk` before the answer. Assistant chunks and `turn_completed` in `completed.updates.jsonl` are negative proof controls. Derived tests change identity/role/marker or replay these bytes into scratch files; they never start a backend.

The fixture does not establish the original pane failure or reproduce the real “Help improve Grok” banner from #3742. No consent button was pressed. The missing late reconciliation is independent of which screen made short proof unproven.
